Citation_Information.description:
The FACET_TABLE is the second part of the shape model file providing the linking of vertices into facets. The integers i1 j1 k1 are the indices of the 3 vertices that form triangular facet 1, and so on. The triple defies an outward normal to the facet following the right-hand rule.This faceted shape model of asteroid 2001 SN263 (alpha) is described in Becker et al. (2015) based on radar and optical photometric observations in January-March 2008. This object is the primary of a triple system. The median model resolution is 140m between vertices. The model center of mass is not exactly aligned with the center of figure, but the offset is within the uncertainty and not significant.
The model has the format
v x1 y1 z1 v x2 y2 z2 v x3 y3 z3 (etc.) f i1 j1 k1 f i2 j2 k2 (etc.)
where the letter 'v' denotes a vertex and the letter 'f' denotes a triangular facet. The VERTEX_TABLE is the first part, describing the positions of the vertices of the shape model. The floating point numbers x1 y1 z1 are the coordinates of vertex 1, and so on (vertices are implicitly numbered beginning with 1). The origin is the model center of mass, and the axes are the principal axes of the shape model. The origin can in principle be offset from the center of figure if the mass distribution is non-uniform. The z-axis is the spin axis or positive pole. The units are kilometers. The linking of vertices into facets is provided in the FACET_TABLE.
This format is identical to a Wavefront OBJ file, supported by most shape meshing and printing software.
